data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'bellum' meaning 'war'. This name is often given to a child born into a family that has faced or is currently facing conflicts and battles, symbolizing strength, courage, and determination. The name Guerra carries the meaning “War” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guerra usually hope their child will grow to embody war and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual warfare, the ongoing battle between good and evil.
